name: Photon
info: Carries the CMB; birefringence β tests an axion coupling c_γ/f (D403, D404).

name: SM neutrinos
info: Observed oscillations; model fixes Σm_ν = 0.0587 eV (m1 ≈ 0), checked by DESI BAO.

name: Inflaton
info: Seen only through the CMB spectrum it seeded: n_s, r, α_s. SERAPIS-E plateau; band n_s 0.970–0.975.

name: Primordial gravitons
info: Tensor modes r ≈ 4.5–5.7e-4; LiteBIRD (~2035) and SO+SPHEREx (~2030) are the tests.

name: Heavy neutrino doublet
info: Γ2 doublet at τ = i, 2⊕1 at ρ; mass splitting η_N; drives leptogenesis.

name: Wino
info: 0.67–1.85 TeV, 5–41 % of dark matter (post-hoc window); HL-LHC disappearing tracks test it.

name: Gravitino
info: Decays to wino; non-thermal share Ω ≤ 3e-4 (Pradler–Steffen), negligible.

name: Axion-like inflaton coupling
info: Unsuppressed coupling at τ = i sets reheating T_R ≈ 1–3e6 GeV.

name: Dark radiation
info: Doublet-only route killed; ΔN_eff bounded by BBN/CMB (filter F7).

name: Modulus / dilaton
info: Must be pinned today: clocks/α-drift ζ ≲ 3.6e-6 (D400); residual displacement ≤ 1e-7–1e-5 M_P.

name: Kaluza–Klein scalar modes
info: String-sector masses: 10D ratio m₂/m₁ 2.190 agrees with BTR; 6D masses pending (S4E4).

name: Baryon asymmetry
info: Observed η_B; the model needs yield 0.87e-10 × dilution D from leptogenesis.

name: Electron
info: Standard Model lepton; α drift / clock tests (F1).

name: Muon
info: Standard Model lepton.

name: Tau lepton
info: Standard Model lepton (charged-lepton sector of the flavour texture).

name: Quarks (u d s c b t)
info: Standard Model; baryons from leptogenesis → sphalerons (8/23 factor).

name: Gluon
info: Standard Model gauge boson.

name: W and Z bosons
info: Electroweak bosons; sphaleron processes convert lepton → baryon asymmetry.

name: Higgs boson
info: Discovered 2012; v = 174 GeV sets the seesaw (y_D = √(m_ν M)/v).

name: Heavy singlet neutrino (2⊕1)
info: The singlet that mixes with the Γ₂ doublet at ρ (D725); M ~ 1e12 GeV.

name: Light heavy-neutrino pair
info: M_L 2e11–2e13 GeV; thermalises and decays (no dark radiation, D1240).

name: Bino
info: AMSB gaugino: M₁ ≈ 3.3 M₂ at one loop (heavier than the wino, which is the LSP). Corrected D1355 (the card said ≈ M₂/2; D809 has no bino).

name: Gluino
info: AMSB gaugino M₃ ≈ 4.7–13 TeV (D809) — beyond LHC reach.

name: Sfermions (squarks, sleptons)
info: Scalars near m₃/₂ ~ 2.5–7e5 GeV — the MSSM spectrum relativistic at reheating (MSSM g*, D1262).

name: Dilaton (string coupling)
info: Im S = 0.485 at the benchmark g_s = 0.232 (D861); stabilised.

name: Stuck D3 branes (string objects)
info: 5 per half-period + 1 at the origin; their asymmetry IS the tilt (D696).

name: Heavy MSSM Higgs bosons
info: The MSSM has two Higgs doublets: besides the 125 GeV Higgs, H⁰, A⁰, H± must exist (mass ~ the soft scale, not computed in the D-notes).

name: Higgsinos
info: Fermion partners of the Higgs doublets (MSSM structure; mass set by μ, not computed).

name: Inflatino
info: Fermion partner of the SUSY inflaton multiplet (τ); mixes with the goldstino during inflation (literature, D-notes ~D120).

name: Goldstino / nilpotent X sector
info: SUSY breaking via a nilpotent X superfield (D649 positivity); the goldstino is eaten by the gravitino.

name: Kähler modulus T₁ (racetrack)
info: Stabilised by a racetrack; Im T₁ = A₂A₃/g_s = 4.31 at the benchmark (D861).
